name: Child of Man
description: (Tag:martial)(Tag:mental)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:talent)You are the child of the God Emperor of Mankind, sharing his gifted physique, charisma, martial prowess, scientific gift, and potential as the strongest Psyker. You can master all non-Chaos Psyker Disciplines and eventually tear apart a planet with Psyker power alone through training, as your power emulates the Warp without connecting to it.
